cohort: The study participants were a cohort of mothers and their infants from Saudi Arabia, whose data were gathered from hospital records to compare complications associated with early- versus late-diagnosed gestational diabetes mellitus.
finding: Early-diagnosed GDM, significantly predicted by high pregestational BMI and GDM history, was linked to a higher incidence of pre-eclampsia, intrauterine fetal death, greater need for glycemic control interventions, and significantly higher fetal birth weight and postpartum BMI.
